name: Mireille Artis
original_name: ミレイユ・アルティス
source:
Affiliation: Cranvar.

A poor girl from Haidopair who she took up a job as a mercenary. Mireille lost her parents in the war when she was little, and at that time she happened to meet Felix, the Count. Through some twists and turns, her life changes for the better as she gains friendships that transcend her status.
